title: Rabbah bar Ivo
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reported in the name of Rav Sheshet, [Gittin 32a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.32a.11). Hyman says the name should also read Rabbah bar Ivo in [Keritot 24b](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.24b.11), where Rabbah bar Avuha appears in error.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Gittin gives Rabbah bar Ivo citing Rav Sheshet and also gives Rabbah bar Avuha as an alternative. The paragraph at the cited Keritot folio gives Rabbah alone. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3200&lang=en) likewise records the Gittin attribution.
